Subject: Claim Decision Regarding {CLAIM_NUMBER}

Dear {CLAIMANT_NAME},

We have completed the review of your claim, {CLAIM_NUMBER}, regarding the glass damage reported on 2026-04-12. We are pleased to inform you that your claim has been approved.

This loss is covered under your comprehensive coverage. According to your policy, [COMP-1] "We will pay for direct and accidental loss to your covered auto not caused by collision, minus the comprehensive deductible shown in the Declarations." Additionally, [COMP-2] "Repair of a windshield chip without replacement is paid with no deductible."

Regarding the next steps, payment of {PAYOUT} will be issued within 5 business days. Please note that a {DEDUCTIBLE} has been applied to this claim.

If you have any questions regarding this decision, please contact us directly.

Sincerely,

ClaimPilot Claims Team
